missing: A side-by-side of every panel that physically plugs into the Spotlight Cam Plus's USB-C port (Ring Small Solar Panel at $39.99, Ring 4W at $59.99, HQST 5W, Wasserstein, dosili and other third-party USB-C panels) with current street prices, in-stock status, and real-world confirmation that each one actually keeps the camera charged (output at 5V, cable length, weather rating, whether Ring's app recognises it), plus a direct cheapest pick.
why: No major reviewer or authority appears at all. The results are Ring's own product page (twice), big-box retailer listings with missing or above-$40 prices, a sold-out refurb listing, two backordered third-party maker pages, a 404, an unreadable Home Depot page, and one dubious drop-ship site. Nobody compares the official panel against third-party USB-C panels on price or tests whether the cheaper ones actually charge a Spotlight Cam Plus. A focused page with current prices across Ring, HQST, Wasserstein and generic panels, stock status, and a direct cheapest-that-works pick would stand out exactly as our solar generator page did.
